svg.title: Three real named transform tracks evaluated by GestureEvaluator and coordinated by FSM_API
svg.desc: Generated by running C# code. FSM_API advances Ready to Running to Complete. GestureEvaluator evaluates 49 samples of one GestureDefinition containing root, tool, and load transforms. All three paths, marker positions, rotations, and scales come from returned transform data. The transforms are independently interpolated and are not composed into a rig hierarchy. Position interpolation is linear.
svg.text: THE SINGULARITY WORKSHOP / GENERATED FROM C#
One procedure. Three evaluated transform tracks.
Real GestureEvaluator output · lifecycle coordinated by FSM_API · browser replays serialized samples

g.text: INDEPENDENT NAMED TRANSFORMS · NOT A RIG HIERARCHY

svg.text: 49 samples · linear position/scale interpolation · quaternion rotation interpolation
